trailhead.label: Ville di Giovo, the APT’s start

cautions: The viewpoint and the ridge are at a cliff edge: keep your dog on a short lead.
A steep, narrow descent through a cleft in the rock ridge, with rough ground.
About 1 km on quiet tarred lanes through the vineyards.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Ville di Giovo, the APT’s start: Ville di Giovo, la partenza indicata dall'APT
textIt.The viewpoint and the ridge are at a cli: Il punto panoramico e la cresta sono sul bordo di una parete rocciosa: tieni il cane con il guinzaglio corto.
textIt.A steep, narrow descent through a cleft: Una discesa ripida e stretta attraverso una fenditura nella cresta rocciosa, su terreno accidentato.
textIt.About 1 km on quiet tarred lanes through: Circa 1 km su tranquille stradine asfaltate tra i vigneti.
